name: gate — 사이클 게이트
description: First pipeline step: may this cycle run?

name: cycle — 매매 결정 한 바퀴
description: One decision pass for declared strategies: bars to signals to intents to risk gates to broker calls out

params.strategyId: run only this strategy (omit = all enabled)
params.barsCacheKey: cache key from the broker's candle response
params.cycleId: idempotency window (omit = derived from the last closed bar)

name: on_stream_event — 실시간 프레임 반응
description: Realtime frames delivered by a stream watch sink (coalesced) - the tick trigger's entry point. 실시간 체결 트리거 스트림

name: record_orders — 주문 응답 기록
description: Record what the broker answered for the cycle's calls: ack moves sent to acked, a rejection is terminal, nothing here ever invents a fill

params.calls: the calls array the cycle emitted

name: reconcile — 잔고·미체결 대조
description: Reconcile the ledger against the broker: balances, open orders, fills; books late fills, expires day orders from past sessions, degrades on mismatch

name: bind_bars — 봉을 전략별 분석 호출로
description: Pipeline step: pair fetched candles with each trade's rules into per-strategy technical-analysis runs. 봉 바인딩 분석 준비

name: context_plan — 맥락 캔들 수집 계획
description: Which context candles (higher timeframes) to fetch this pass. 맥락 수집 계획

name: store_context — 맥락 캔들 저장
description: Store fetched context bars into the module's candle cache (context.db). 맥락 저장

name: context — 맥락 캔들 읽기
description: Read stored context bars for a symbol/timeframe. 맥락 조회

name: report — 원장 종합 리포트
description: THE read surface: positions, orders, recent events, realised/unrealised PnL, health state and attention flags in one call

params.store: live (real+mock accounts) | dryrun (paper); omit = current mode
params.marks: current prices {symbol: price} for unrealised PnL

name: positions — 보유 포지션 조회
description: Current holdings per strategy from the ledger: quantity, average cost, state. 보유 포지션 잔고 수량 평단가 조회

name: orders — 주문 기록 조회
description: Order rows the module placed: state (sent/acked/filled/canceled/unknown), prices, broker order numbers. 주문 내역 미체결 상태 조회

name: ledger — 원장 원행 조회
description: Raw append-only ledger rows (buys, sells, transfers, fees). 원장 장부 거래 기록

name: pnl — 실현 손익
description: Realised profit as the ledger states it - today and cumulative, per strategy and per symbol, fees and taxes separated

name: 청산 close_position (UI 전용)
description: UI-ONLY: refused from chat/FC/MCP by policy - run it from the settings screen's ledger tab button (설정 > 자동매매 > 원장 탭)

params.store: live | dryrun - which book the buttons act on

name: 전부 청산 liquidate_all (UI 전용)
description: UI-ONLY: refused from chat/FC/MCP by policy - run it from the settings screen's ledger tab button (설정 > 자동매매 > 원장 탭)

name: 유령 수량 정정 write_off (UI 전용)
description: UI-ONLY: refused from chat/FC/MCP by policy - run it from the settings screen's ledger tab button (설정 > 자동매매 > 원장 탭)

params.note: why - recorded on the ledger row

name: 미배정 배정 resolve_unassigned (UI 전용)
description: UI-ONLY: refused from chat/FC/MCP by policy - run it from the settings screen's ledger tab button (설정 > 자동매매 > 원장 탭)

name: 포지션 이동 move_position (UI 전용)
description: UI-ONLY: refused from chat/FC/MCP by policy - run it from the settings screen's ledger tab button (설정 > 자동매매 > 원장 탭)

params.toStrategyId: taking on (must be a strategy that actually runs)

name: 미체결 전부 취소 cancel_all
description: Withdraw every resting order (optionally one broker/account). Human action, approval-gated. 미체결 일괄 취소 주문 취소

name: 보유 반입 import_position
description: Import an existing brokerage holding into a strategy's book at a stated price. Human action, approval-gated. 보유 종목 반입 이관

name: halt — 킬스위치
description: Trip the kill switch - one direction only; clearing it is a settings change. 중지 정지 킬스위치

name: resume — 재개
description: Clear a tripped state after a ledger replay agrees the books are consistent. Human action, approval-gated. 재개 재가동

name: selftest — 자체 검사
description: Golden fixtures over the engine, store and actions - touches no network. 자체 테스트

name: plan_sweep — 탐색 공간 전개
description: Expand a declared search space into candidate runs (each = one technical-analysis call, fitted on one window, scored on another)

name: rank_sweep — 스윕 채점
description: Rank one symbol's sweep results on the holdout window; flags thin samples and in-sample-only rules. 스윕 순위 채점 검증

name: merge_sweeps — 종목 간 합산
description: Fold one symbol's ranking into a running total across symbols (call once per symbol). 스윕 합산 누적

name: rank_across — 최종 순위
description: Final ranking over every symbol swept, ordered by how consistently a rule beat buy and hold. 최종 순위 일관성

name: plan_multi — 다종목 스윕 계획
description: The whole multi-symbol sweep as one planning call - the pipeline stays four steps whatever the symbol count. 다종목 스윕 계획

name: rank_multi — 다종목 스윕 채점
description: Read the multi-symbol sweep results back and rank them on the holdout window. 다종목 채점

name: fit_symbols — 종목별 적합
description: Fit rule variants per symbol from sweep output. 종목별 적합

name: adopt — 전략 채택
description: Adopt a ranked rule as an AI strategy at the ladder's paper stage

name: adopt_fits — 적합 결과 채택
description: Adopt fitted per-symbol results (same bar as adopt). 적합 채택

name: strategies — AI 전략 목록
description: List stored AI strategies with their ladder stage. AI 전략 목록 조회

name: retire — 전략 은퇴
description: Retire an AI strategy (kept in the store, no longer runs). 전략 은퇴 제거

name: review — 야간 복기
description: Nightly review of adopted strategies: their own ledger decides promotion or demotion on the paper-mock-real ladder. 야간 복기 승격 강등

name: next_revision — 도전자 생성
description: Challenger loop: propose the next revision of a human strategy as a separate AI-owned paper copy, scored in the shadow book. 개선판 도전자 리비전

name: request_condition — 조건검색 요청
description: Build the HTS condition-search watch request for a trade's universe. 조건검색 요청

name: bind_condition — 조건검색 편입 반영
description: Bind condition-search results (enter/leave frames) into a trade's watchlist. 조건검색 편입 이탈

name: match_conditions — 조건식 이름 매칭
description: Match declared condition names against the broker's condition list. 조건식 매칭

name: universe — 워치리스트 조회
description: Read a trade's current watchlist (screen/condition members). 유니버스 워치리스트 조회

name: screen_rank — 순위 응답으로 목록 채우기
description: Fill a trade's watchlist from a broker ranking response - pass the whole payload, the array is found whatever the broker named it
